decision: All four original hunks strengthen the existing compareTime case in the date-fns, Luxon, Moment and native adapters. They replace one shared calendar date with Jan1 and Feb7 while preserving six time comparisons and their two negative, one equal and three positive results per adapter. No case, production parser, adapter algorithm or public API is added or changed. The complete owned product contains no ordinary date-adapter fork; public current datepicker/native-adapter use is reachable through the legacy form-field harness and Cyph. Do not copy peer private adapter specs or claim inherited correct time parsing/comparison merely because the tests changed. This excludes those private test changes from owned source adaptation only; actual public peer/datepicker interoperability and supported-floor gates remain separate.
